secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service-role key (Project Settings → API → service_role secret). Required for admin/server-side DB operations; the public landing page renders without it via built-in publishable-key fallbacks.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL. Optional — the app has a built-in fallback publishable pair.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase publishable/anon key. Optional — the app has a built-in fallback.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL
secrets.description: Canonical site URL for SEO (defaults to https://medprep.pk).

secrets.name: EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID
secrets.description: EmailJS service ID for enrollment/approval/rejection emails. Optional.

secrets.name: EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID_ENROLLMENT
secrets.description: EmailJS template ID for enrollment emails. Optional.

secrets.name: EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID_APPROVAL
secrets.description: EmailJS template ID for approval emails. Optional.

secrets.name: EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID_REJECTION
secrets.description: EmailJS template ID for rejection emails. Optional.

secrets.name: EMAILJS_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.description: EmailJS public key. Optional.

secrets.name: EMAILJS_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: EmailJS private key. Optional.

secrets.name: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.description: VAPID public key for web push notifications. Optional.

secrets.name: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: VAPID private key for web push notifications. Optional.

secrets.name: VAPID_SUBJECT
secrets.description: VAPID subject (mailto: or https: URL) for web push. Optional.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.description: Public VAPID key inlined into the client bundle. Optional.

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.description: WhatsApp Cloud API access token for daily quiz messaging. Optional.

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
secrets.description: WhatsApp Cloud API phone number ID. Optional.

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN
secrets.description: WhatsApp webhook verify token. Optional.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID for Google Drive content ingestion. Optional.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Google OAuth client secret. Optional.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Google OAuth refresh token. Optional.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID
secrets.description: Google Drive folder ID for content ingestion. Optional.

secrets.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Typesafe AI SDK API key. Optional.

secrets.name: CRON_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret protecting cron API routes. Optional.

secrets.name: INDEXNOW_KEY
secrets.description: IndexNow key for SEO ping. Optional.

secrets.name: MAINTENANCE_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base URL for maintenance cron. Optional.
